headline: Q2FY27 Company Update

highlights: Revenue from operations grew 11% YoY but declined 11% QoQ to Rs40.67bn, while total income stood at Rs45.54bn.
Transaction charges rose 9% YoY to Rs30.35bn, contributing 75% of operating revenue.
Operating EBITDA increased 107% YoY but declined 14% QoQ to Rs30.79bn.
PAT rose 23% YoY but declined 17% QoQ to Rs25.78bn, with EPS at Rs10.41.
